claim.claim-text: CLAIMS:
1. A neuroprotective composition characterized in that it comprises a therapeutically effective amount of ceruloplasmin or a functional derivative thereof.
2. The neuroprotective composition of claim 1 , characterized in that it protects neuronal cells from reactive oxygen species.
3. The neuroprotective composition of claim 2, characterized in that said reactive oxygen species are selected from the group consisting of #02" and *OH.

4. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 1 to 3, characterized in that it further comprises an antioxidant consisting of: i) catalase; or ii) an amphiphilic physiological antioxidative solution; ceruloplasmin or the functional derivative of ceruloplasmin and said antioxidant being present in the neuroprotective composition in an amount that have a synergistic beneficial effect on neuronal cells.

5. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 1 to 4, characterized in that ceruloplasmin or its functional derivative is purified from blood using an one-step affinity chromatography on aminoethyl-agarose.
6. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 1 to 5, characterized in that ceruloplasmin or its functional derivative is present in an amount varying from about 0.05 μM to about 20 μM.

7. The neuroprotective composition of claim 4, characterized in that said amphiphilic physiological antioxidative solution comprises a mixture of pyruvate, at least one antioxidant and at least one lipid.

8. The neuroprotective composition of claim 7, characterized in that said at least one lipid consist of at least one fatty acid is selected from the group consisting of monogylcerides , digylcerides, trigylcerides, free fatty acids, and mixtures thereof.
9. The neuroprotective composition of claim 8, characterized in that said at least one fatty acid consist of a mixture of saturated and unsaturated fatty acids.

10. The neuroprotective composition of claim 9, characterized in that said fatty acids are present in an amount varying from about 0.001% v/v to about 1% v/v, by weight of the cardioprotective composition.

11. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 10, characterized in that pyruvate is selected from the group consisting of pyruvic acid, pharmaceutically acceptable salts of pyruvic acid, prod rugs of pyruvic acid, and mixtures thereof.
12. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 11 , characterized in that pyruvate is present in said composition in an amount varying from about 0.01 mM to about 100 mM.
13. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 12, characterized in that said at least one antioxidant is selected from lipid-soluble antioxidants.

14. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 13, characterized in that said at least one antioxidant is selected from the group consisting of Vitamin A, carotene, Vitamin E, pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and mixtures thereof.

15. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 14, characterized in that said at least one antioxidant is selected from the group consisting of Vitamin E, Vitamin E acetate and analogues of Vitamin E.

16. The neuroprotective composition of any one of claims 7 to 15, characterized in that said at least one antioxidant is present in an amount varying from about 0.01 unit/ml to about 10 unit/ml of said composition.

17. The cardioprotective composition of any one of claims 1 to 16, characterized in that it further comprises an agent selected from the group consisting of metal chelators, metal scavengers, proteinic chelators, proteinic scavengers, preserving agents, solubilizing agents, stabilizing agents, wetting agents, emulsifiers, sweeteners, colorants, odorants, salts, buffers and coating agents.
18. Use of a composition according to any one of claims 1 to 17, as an active agent in the preparation of a medication for the treatment of neuronal cells.

19. Use of a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of: i) ceruloplasmin or a functional derivative thereof; or ii) component i) in combination with catalase or in combination with a mixture of pyruvate, at least one antioxidant and at least one lipid; for the treatment of neuronal cells.

20. The use of claim 18 or 19, for the treatment of brain trauma, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, neurodegenerative diseases, poisoning of neuronal cells, the diminution of drugs side effects and for preservation of neuronal grafts.

21. A method for treating a neuronal oxidative stress related condition comprising the administration to a patient in need thereof of a therapeutically effective amount of a neuroprotective composition comprising: i) ceruloplasmin or a functional derivative thereof; or ii) component i) in combination with catalase or in combination with a mixture of pyruvate, at least one antioxidant and at least one lipid.
22. A method for treating a neuronal oxidative stress related condition comprising:

- administrating to a patient in need thereof of a therapeutically effective amount of an antioxidative composition comprising ceruloplasmin or a functional derivative thereof, pyruvate and at least one antioxidant; and
- providing into blood circulation of said patient at least one lipid having a synergistic therapeutic effect on cardiac cells in combination with said antioxidative composition.
23. The method of claim 22, characterized in that said at least one lipid is provided to said patient by increasing its lipidic blood level ratio through its diet.

24. The method of claim 22 or 23, characterized in that said neuronal oxidative stress related condition is a brain trauma, brain or cerebrovascular ischemia, a neurodegenerative disease, neuronal cells poisoning, side effects caused by a drug or handling a neuronal graft.

25. A method for preparing a neuroprotective composition, characterized in that it comprises the steps of: d) providing a therapeutically effective amount of i) cerulopiasmin or a functional derivative of cerulopiasmin, ii) pyruvate, iii) at least one antioxidant and iv) at least one lipid; and e) mixing together components i), ii), iii) and iv) of step a) in a buffered saline solution to obtain a pharmaceutically acceptable homologous suspension.
26. The method of claim 25, characterized in that said buffered saline solution comprises sodium, potassium, magnesium and calcium ions at physiological concentrations.

27. The method of claim 25 or 25, characterized in that characterized in that it further comprises at least one of the steps of centrifuging or filtering the homologous suspension obtained in step b).
